faqs.a:
Whenever the council shall deem it necessary to enter into any contract by ordinance,
               it shall follow the procedure now set forth in this Code or in the Charter for the
               passage of ordinances not of an emergency nature or making a general codification
               of ordinances or ordinances adopting standard codes.
(Code 1960, § 2-3.3(a); Code 1981, § 2-35)
Charter reference—
Adoption by ordinance, §§ 5-7, 5-8.
State Law reference—
Power of city to enter into contracts, C.R.S. § 31-15-101.
